scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Power Looks Good
cards.instruction: Act fascinated by confident behavior; imitate it closely while resenting how naturally it seems to work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That pause of yours made everyone listen. I'll use a longer one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a cough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An authoritative cough. Mine will be deliberate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need to copy me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say that again. I like the certainty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your pause silenced the committee. I'll copy it for my report. Annoying how easily that works for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was holding back a cough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even your cough commands respect. How long did you hold it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just say, 'I'd like your attention.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like your attention. Was that your exact tone? You make four words look hereditary.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies the pause and A5 admires certainty, but neither expresses resentment at B's effortless success.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 converts B2's cough into authority; A5 starts copying the certainty of B4's objection.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects A's interpretation and B4 asks not to be copied, giving B an independent boundary.

heightening.evidence: A5 extends imitation from B's cough to B4's attempt to stop the imitation.

specificity.evidence: A1 mentions making everyone listen but leaves the occasion and A's next speaking task unclear.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'authoritative cough' and A5's request to repeat the objection are compact consequences of fascination.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 admires and resents the commanding pause; A3 studies its duration; A5 copies B's words and envies the apparently inherited tone.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's cough becomes A3's model of authority; B4's suggested sentence becomes A5's exact rehearsal.

relationship.evidence: B2 punctures A's interpretation and B4 offers practical help, although B's own committee responsibility remains unspecified.

heightening.evidence: After B4 simplifies the task, A5 makes even four ordinary words evidence of B's inaccessible natural advantage.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a committee report and an observed pause; A5 supplies immediately playable vocal imitation.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's commanding cough and A5's 'hereditary' delivery follow A's envy, though A1 states the attitude explicitly.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 reveals a suppressed cough; A3 interprets that specific involuntary behavior as another technique worth copying.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 supplies the attention request; A5 repeats it and checks the exact tone.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 combine fascination, close imitation and resentment of B's ease.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: B4's helpful simplification increases A5's conviction that even elementary speech comes naturally only to B.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A studies and closely copies B's apparently effortless confidence while begrudging B that ease.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Competitive imitation alone: original A1 wants a longer pause, but A3 and A5 show admiration without the required resentment.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A1 explicitly resents B's ease; A3 studies the cough and A5 copies B4's precise wording and tone.

records.recommendedEdit: The original omits part of the instruction. The revision introduces a committee report as an illustrative setting. Internal second read, coach-1.0: fidelity 5 (A1/A5), logic 5 (B2/A3 and B4/A5), relationship 4 (B4 offers practical help), heightening 4 (A5 studies the offered phrase), specificity 5 (A1), brevity 4 (A5); total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words; hard gates pass. No live or independent review performed.
records.remainingConcern: A1 announces envy rather directly. No rewrite needed for an internal pass.
records.writerReservation: A5's hereditary metaphor is slightly polished for spontaneous speech.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a uses a colleague's verbal coaching; b uses physical imitation while a dining companion needs to leave.

cards.title: Power Looks Good
cards.instruction: Act fascinated by confident behavior; imitate it closely while resenting how naturally it seems to work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You got the table just by raising an eyebrow. Must be nice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could ask the waiter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. I'm developing a stronger eyebrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's coming over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Watch mine outperform yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You got us this table with one raised eyebrow. Show me. Must be nice having that face.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I raised the left one. But please just ask for the bill; I'm late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Left. Like this? You barely moved yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's coming. Keep it there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You got a table in a second. I'm getting a cramp asking for paper.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1's 'Must be nice' supplies resentment and A3 imitates the eyebrow, although A5 emphasizes outperforming more than close imitation.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 rejects B2's verbal request tactic; B4's approaching waiter creates the occasion for A5's demonstration.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers useful advice, but B4 merely announces the waiter without giving B a clear personal stake.

heightening.evidence: A5 promises that the eyebrow will outperform B's, largely repeating A3's stronger-eyebrow ambition.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a restaurant table and an observable gesture that actors can immediately play.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'developing a stronger eyebrow' is concise and follows A1's misplaced admiration.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 envies B's face, A3 copies the left eyebrow precisely, and A5 resents the physical cost of reproducing B's easy authority.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 specifies the left eyebrow and the bill; A3 follows that detail. B4 requires holding the expression, producing A5's cramp.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants the bill because B is late; B4 helps the attempt work while keeping A committed to it.

heightening.evidence: B4's 'Keep it there' turns A3's brief imitation into A5's painful sustained effort.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes restaurant seating; B2 adds the bill and lateness; A3's left-eyebrow imitation is physically precise.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 contrasts a table gained instantly with a cramp over the bill; 'paper' is slightly less natural than the earlier wording.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies the left eyebrow; A3 explicitly copies that side and compares the effort.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 tells the character to sustain the eyebrow as the waiter approaches; A5 reports the resulting cramp.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A's exact physical copying remains inseparable from admiration and resentment.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: Imitation develops from observation into bodily discomfort under B's time pressure.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A treats B's effortless confident gesture as a technique worth copying exactly and resents the effort copying costs.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: One-upmanship: original A5 wants to outperform B, whereas the instruction also requires fascination and close imitation.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised B2 specifies the left eyebrow, A3 copies it precisely, and A5 contrasts A's cramp with B's effortless success.

records.recommendedEdit: The original final beat repeats competitive intent. The revision preserves the restaurant and adds an overdue bill. Second internal read: fidelity 5 (A1/A3/A5), logic 5 (B2 supplies left; B4 requires holding), relationship 4 (B2 is late), heightening 4 (A5 persists through cramp), specificity 5 (A1/B2), brevity 4 (A5); total 92. Hard gates pass; under 75 words.
records.remainingConcern: A5's 'asking for paper' sounds shaped for the joke. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 needs sincere frustration rather than a knowing delivery of the cramp joke.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike a's workplace voice coaching, b gives B a deadline and makes imitation physically costly.
